title: OpenMMS real-world injection-mould monitoring raw case study

experimentalContext.faultMethod: A screw is tightened against the ejector/extraction pin containing the force sensor; the fault is released and re-applied in repeated steps.
experimentalContext.purpose: Distinguish normal and abnormal mould operation using pressure, temperature, extraction force and inertial sensing.

units.nextAction: Map each unit only from paper/source code or a publisher/author data dictionary.

profileStatus.reasonIncomplete: The connected GitHub API exposes the pinned 2.87 MB raw blob and verified header/content, but the current analysis interface does not provide a safe full-file local stream for deterministic row/missingness calculation. Counts are therefore not guessed.

governance.rightsDecision: Repository license and paper data-availability route are strong, but dataset-specific redistribution scope should still be recorded explicitly before MouldMaster republishes raw rows.

promotionGate: Obtain/record dataset-specific reuse interpretation for the raw CSV.
Run deterministic full-file parser against the pinned blob and record exact row count/missingness/ranges.
Derive cycle boundaries without leaking fault labels across train/test splits.
Preserve the first 54 normal cycles and later fault intervention chronologically.
Do not treat the simulated extraction fault as a natural wear-history dataset.
